name: Google AI Studio (Gemini API)
free_models: Gemini 3.8 Flash (preview) — free-tier RPM/TPM/RPD: see AI Studio (per-model, per-project; not published as fixed numbers on rate-limits page)
Gemini 3.6 Flash (preview) — free-tier RPM/TPM/RPD: see AI Studio
Gemini 3.5 Flash-Lite (preview) — free-tier RPM/TPM/RPD: see AI Studio
Gemini 3.1 Flash-Lite (preview) — free-tier RPM/TPM/RPD: see AI Studio
Gemini 2.5 Pro — free-tier RPM/TPM/RPD: see AI Studio
Gemini 2.5 Flash — free-tier RPM/TPM/RPD: see AI Studio
Gemini 2.5 Flash-Lite — free-tier RPM/TPM/RPD: see AI Studio
Gemini Decision 1 (Decisions API) — Free tier: 200 RPM, 50,000 TPM, 10,000 RPD (as listed on rate-limits page)
Gemini Omni Flash — Free tier: not supported (official rate-limits page)
Genie 4 — Free tier: not supported (official rate-limits page)
limits: Free tier is available in eligible countries/projects; per-project interactive rate limits (RPM/TPM/RPD) differ by model and project and are shown in Google AI Studio (official page: 'view your active rate limits in AI Studio'). RPD resets at midnight Pacific time. Concrete free-tier numbers confirmed on official rate-limits page: Gemini Decision 1 (Decisions API) Free = 200 RPM, 50,000 TPM, 10,000 RPD; Gemini Omni Flash Free = not supported; Genie 4 Free = not supported. For other Gemini models (including Gemini 3.x Flash/Flash-Lite and Gemini 2.5 models), the official rate-limits page does not publish fixed free-tier RPM/TPM/RPD numbers — see AI Studio for active per-model limits. Specified limits are not guaranteed and actual capacity may vary.
region_notes: Available in supported countries/territories; free-tier content may be used to improve Google products per terms.

name: Groq
limits: Organization-level rate limits. As listed on Groq docs (2026-11-24): gpt-oss-120b 30 RPM, 1K RPD, 8K TPM, 200K TPD; gpt-oss-20b 30 RPM, 1K RPD, 8K TPM, 200K TPD; qwen/qwen3.8-27b 30 RPM, 1K RPD, 8K TPM, 200K TPD; whisper-large-v3 20 RPM, 2K RPD, 7.2K ASH, 28.8K ASD; whisper-large-v3-turbo 20 RPM, 2K RPD, 7.2K ASH, 28.8K ASD. Check console Limits page for current account limits.
region_notes: Service availability subject to Groq supported regions and terms.

name: OpenRouter
free_models: Models with `:free` suffix (rotating catalog; see OpenRouter models list)
limits: Free-model variants (`:free`): 20 requests/minute. 50 requests/day if account has purchased less than 10 credits total; 1000 requests/day after at least 10 credits purchased. Additional platform/account limits may apply.
region_notes: Global routing service; model/provider availability varies.

name: Cloudflare Workers AI
free_models: Other models in Workers AI catalog
limits: 10,000 Neurons per day at no charge on Workers Free and Paid plans. Limits reset daily at 00:00 UTC. Usage above free allocation requires Workers Paid plan and is billed per Neurons. Per-model limits may apply.
region_notes: Served via Cloudflare global network; account/feature availability subject to Cloudflare terms.

name: Mistral AI (La Plateforme)
free_models: Models available in Mistral Free/Experiment mode (availability shown in console; varies over time)
limits: Free mode provides API access with no credit card required for experimentation and prototyping. Rate limits apply; exact limits are shown in the AI Studio/La Plateforme Limits page for your organization and are not published as fixed public numbers.
region_notes: Service availability and data-use policy depend on plan/terms; review Mistral terms before production use.

name: Cohere
free_models: Command A / Command A Reasoning / Command A Vision (trial)
Command R+ / Command R / Command R7B
Embed, Rerank, Tokenize, and other endpoints on trial key
limits: Trial keys are free but limited: 1,000 API calls/month total. Chat: 20 req/min on trial. Embed: 2,000 inputs/min; Embed (Images): 5 inputs/min; Rerank: 10 req/min; Tokenize: 100 req/min. Trial keys are not for production use.
region_notes: Global service; trial usage subject to Cohere terms.

name: Z.ai (GLM API)
limits: Listed at $0 for input, cached input, and output on Z.ai's official pricing. Z.ai does not publish fixed public numeric rate limits for free models; standard API rate limits and Terms of Service apply. Verify current limits in console.
region_notes: Service availability and data policy vary by region; review Z.ai terms.

name: OVHcloud AI Endpoints
limits: Anonymous access: 2 requests/minute per IP per model, no signup/API key required. Authenticated access with Public Cloud API key: 400 requests/minute per project per model (payment method required for API key use as documented). Exceeding limits returns HTTP 429.
region_notes: EU-hosted (OVHcloud). Anonymous tier has no signup; authenticated higher limits require Public Cloud project with payment method.

name: Scaleway Generative APIs
free_models: Models in Scaleway Generative APIs catalog (examples: Llama 3.3 70B Instruct, GPT-OSS 120B, Qwen3 Coder 30B A3B Instruct; catalog varies)
limits: Free Tier: 1,000,000 tokens for models billed by tokens and 60 minutes of audio transcription for models billed by audio minutes. After free tier, usage is billed. Organization quotas/rate limits apply and depend on account validation; check Scaleway console for current limits.
region_notes: EU-hosted (Paris, France). Valid payment method/identity verification may be required for quotas.

name: Cerebras Inference
limits: Free Trial provides $5 in credits (expires 30 days after grant) after adding a verified payment method; no permanent no-card free tier. Trial limits: gpt-oss-120b 5 RPM, 30K uncached TPM, 90K total TPM, 1M TPH, 1M TPD; qwen-3.8-27b 300 RPM, 150K uncached TPM, 750K total TPM.
region_notes: Payment method required to activate trial; service subject to Cerebras terms.

name: Vercel AI Gateway
free_models: Free-tier subset of models routed through Vercel AI Gateway (model availability varies; see dashboard/docs)
limits: $5/month in included AI Gateway credits on eligible Hobby accounts and teams. Free-tier subset of models only; lower per-model rate limits apply and requests may return HTTP 429 when exceeded. BYOK is not available on the free tier. Purchasing credits moves the account to paid tier and the monthly $5 free credit no longer applies.
region_notes: Global edge platform; model/provider availability and data handling vary by upstream provider.

name: Kilo Gateway
free_models: Models tagged `:free` in Kilo Gateway catalog (includes `kilo-auto/free`; live catalog varies)
limits: Free models are available at no cost and subject to rate limits. All free-model requests (anonymous and authenticated) are rate-limited to 200 requests/hour per IP; requests above the limit return HTTP 429. Paid models are not gateway-rate-limited.
region_notes: Global service; anonymous access allowed; free requests rate-limited by IP.

name: Alibaba Cloud Model Studio
free_models: Select Qwen and other models marked with free quota in Model Studio (Singapore/International scope; varies by model/release)
limits: New-user free quota for eligible models in Singapore region with International scope. Quota is typically 1,000,000 tokens per model, valid for 90 days from activation/model release/approval (whichever is later), and covers real-time inference only. Quota is not shared across models; unused quota expires. After exhaustion/expiry, pay-as-you-go billing applies unless Free Quota Only is enabled.
region_notes: Singapore region, International scope only for the documented new-user free quota; account information/verification may be required before activation.
